research.locationNote: Yas Canal, Abu Dhabi; brochure: Yas Island; factsheet: 11 minutes from Yas Island.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives a launch guide of AED 865,000 and AED 864,921 in its FAQ; Tanami advertises AED 750,000. Release, discount and unit selection may differ; no primary live price list was verified.
research.paymentNote: The reference table follows Property Finder’s 20 / 80 plan. Tanami advertises a 5% booking option without a complete calendar. No dated original commercial schedule was verified; confirm the selected offer.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder targets December 2030. This is a forecast, not a verified contractual date or construction certificate.

unresolved: Visible totals override conflicting hidden layers. Some printed components do not reconcile. E2 Type P is labelled three-bedroom but draws four bedrooms.
The launch gives approximately 140,700 m²; the factsheet gives 144,703 m². These masterplan plots differ from the 9,165 m² E1/E2 parcel.
Figures include outdoor areas and whole duplexes. Townhouse and other-cluster dimensions, current charges, inventory, contracted revisions and completion status remain unverified.
